_readme: All prices are in JOD per person. 'tiers' list the price per person by group size (number of guests aged 3 and over). A price of null means 'contact us for a price'. Edit this file, then run: python3 tools/build.py

overnight_options.name: Bedouin tent, shared bathroom
overnight_options.note: Included in the tour price. Single, double, triple and family tents.

overnight_options.name: Deluxe tent, private bathroom
overnight_options.image_alt: A deluxe tent with a glass front

overnight_options.name: Sleeping under the stars
overnight_options.note: 5 JOD extra per person, dinner and breakfast included.
overnight_options.image_alt: Blankets under the night sky in the desert

groups.name: Jeep tours & overnight
groups.blurb: Explore Wadi Rum by 4x4 with a local Bedouin guide, then spend the night at our camp.

groups.name: Mountains & hiking
groups.blurb: For walkers and climbers: rock bridges, summits and long trails between the mountains.

groups.name: Multi-day adventures
groups.blurb: Two to four days in the desert with a Bedouin guide, deep into the quiet parts of Wadi Rum.

groups.name: Desert experiences
groups.blurb: Shorter experiences on their own, or added to any tour.

programmes.name: Full-Day Jeep Tour + Overnight
programmes.summary: The complete Wadi Rum in one day: red dunes, canyons and viewpoints, with time to walk, climb and take photos.
description: A full day in the jeep covering the main highlights of Wadi Rum. There is time to explore on foot, climb up for the views and take as many photos as you like, with lunch in the desert along the way.
In the evening we find a good spot to watch the sunset, then drive back to camp for dinner by the fire. Spend the night in a Bedouin tent, or sleep out under the stars.
includes: Full-day jeep tour with a local guide
programmes.image_alt: Jeeps parked at a desert viewpoint in Wadi Rum

programmes.name: Half-Day Jeep Tour + Overnight
programmes.summary: An afternoon among Wadi Rum's best-known sights, then sunset, dinner and a night at camp.
description: Set off after lunch to explore some of Wadi Rum's main attractions by jeep, stopping to walk and take photos as the light turns warm.
Watch the sunset over the desert, then settle in at camp for dinner, the fire and a quiet night.
includes: Half-day jeep tour with a local guide
programmes.image_alt: Sunset over the Wadi Rum desert

programmes.name: 3-Hour Jeep Tour + Overnight
programmes.summary: Short on time? A 3-hour drive to some of the most beautiful places in the desert, with sunset, dinner and a night at camp.
description: Made for travellers with limited time. In three hours we visit some of the most beautiful places in Wadi Rum and finish with the sunset.
Then it's dinner at camp and a night in the desert, with breakfast in the morning before you go.
includes: 3-hour jeep tour with a local guide
programmes.image_alt: View over the sand and mountains of Wadi Rum

programmes.name: White Desert Experience + Overnight
programmes.summary: Leave the red sand behind for Wadi Rum's pale white desert, with its strange rock formations and quiet, open landscapes.
description: Explore the white desert areas of Wadi Rum, where the sand turns pale and the rocks take on unusual shapes. It is a very different landscape from the classic red desert, and far quieter.
Finish the day with a night at camp, or sleep out under the stars.
includes: Day tour to the white desert with a local guide
Overnight at camp or under the stars
programmes.image_alt: Pale sandstone rock formation in Wadi Rum

programmes.name: Jabal Burdah Adventure + Overnight
programmes.summary: Drive and hike to Jabal Burdah and climb up to its famous rock bridge, high above the desert floor.
description: A jeep and hiking adventure to Jabal Burdah and its famous rock bridge, one of the most impressive natural arches in Wadi Rum. The climb involves steep sections and some scrambling, and the views from the top reach across the mountains.
After the hike, spend the night camping in the desert.
programmes.fitness: Steep hiking with some scrambling. Tell us your experience and we'll advise.
programmes.image_alt: Natural rock bridge in Wadi Rum

programmes.name: Umm ad Dami Adventure + Overnight
programmes.summary: Climb Jabal Umm ad Dami, the highest mountain in Jordan at 1,854 m, with views across the desert in every direction.
description: Jabal Umm ad Dami is the highest mountain in Jordan. This adventure combines a jeep ride deep into the south of Wadi Rum with a hike to the summit, where the desert stretches out in every direction.
After coming down, spend the night at camp.
includes: Jeep transfer and guided summit hike
programmes.fitness: A steep summit hike. Tell us your experience and we'll advise.
programmes.image_alt: Bedouin tea on a summit with a view over Wadi Rum

programmes.name: 2-Day Wadi Rum Adventure
programmes.summary: A full-day jeep tour, a day hiking Al-Hash Mountain, Wadi Sabat and Nagza, one night at camp and one night under the stars.
description: Experience the beauty of Wadi Rum through a full-day jeep tour, mountain hiking, Bedouin culture and a night under the stars.
You spend the first night at our camp and the second in a quiet desert spot, away from the camp lights.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Full-day jeep tour
items: Abu Khashaba Valley and a short hike
Dinner and overnight at the camp

itinerary.title: Day 2: Al-Hash Mountain, Wadi Sabat and Nagza
items: Hiking with a Bedouin guide on Al-Hash Mountain
Hike through the mountains and desert valleys
Dinner and a night under the stars, away from the camp lights

itinerary.title: Day 3: Breakfast and departure
items: Free time to enjoy the peaceful surroundings

includes: Al-Hash Mountain hike, Wadi Sabat and Nagza
1 night at camp + 1 night under the stars
programmes.fitness: Day 2 is a long hiking day. Tell us your experience and we'll advise.
programmes.image_alt: A hiker on a ridge above the desert

programmes.name: 3-Day Wadi Rum Adventure
programmes.image_alt: Looking out of a desert cave in Wadi Rum
programmes.summary: The hidden side of Wadi Rum: the famous sights by jeep, then Jabal Al-Hash, the White Desert and the remote valleys of Wadi Sabet.
description: Experience the hidden side of Wadi Rum with local Bedouin guides, exploring mountains, white desert landscapes and remote valleys, and sleeping under the stars.
Choose two nights at the camp, or spend the second night in a natural desert cave. The cave is a simple, authentic desert experience: no electricity and no tent, just complete silence and the stars.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Full-day jeep tour of Wadi Rum
items: Sunset in the desert with Bedouin tea
Dinner and overnight at the camp

itinerary.title: Day 2: Jabal Al-Hash and the White Desert
items: Breakfast, then deep into the desert for the day
Remote landscapes, hidden valleys and mountains
Traditional Bedouin dinner and overnight at the camp
itinerary.note: Optional: instead of returning to the camp, spend the night in a natural desert cave under the stars.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Wadi Sabet and remote valleys
items: Breakfast, then on to the less-visited areas of Wadi Rum
Silence and landscapes away from the busy tourist areas

programmes.fitness: Short hikes on days 2 and 3. Fine for most people with normal fitness.

programmes.name: 4-Day Wadi Rum Desert Trek
programmes.image_alt: Stone cairns along a desert trail in Wadi Rum
programmes.summary: Four days walking through the heart of Wadi Rum with a Bedouin guide, a support vehicle and a team who cook and set up camp.
description: Experience Wadi Rum on foot with a local Bedouin guide and a support team. Spend four days exploring the desert, mountains, valleys and hidden areas while walking through the heart of Wadi Rum.

Your guide walks with you every day, while the support vehicle carries your luggage and equipment. Another member of the team prepares your meals and sets up your sleeping area each evening, in a different desert location every night.
A complete private trekking experience.
includes: 4 days of trekking with a Bedouin hiking guide
Driver and support vehicle for luggage and equipment
A team member who cooks and sets up camp
Breakfast, lunch and dinner every day (traditional Bedouin meals)
Camping in a different desert location each night
programmes.fitness: Several hours of walking each day on sand and rocky trails. Tell us your experience and we'll advise.

programmes.name: Camel Ride
programmes.summary: Travel the desert the way Bedouin families have for generations. Ride at sunrise, at sunset or at a time that suits you.
description: Choose a short ride of 30 minutes or an hour, a longer two-hour ride, or a full day on camelback. Sunrise and sunset are the most beautiful times, but we can arrange the ride whenever suits you.

options.name: Full day
options.note: plus a camel for the guide

programmes.image_alt: A saddled camel at the camp

programmes.name: Stargazing Experience
programmes.summary: Two hours in a quiet spot far from the camp lights, where the Milky Way stretches across the sky. Add it to any tour.
description: After dinner we drive to a quiet place away from the camp lights, where the desert sky is at its darkest. Two hours to lie back and watch the stars, with the Milky Way overhead on clear nights.
Stargazing can be added to the end of any tour.
includes: 2 hours with a guide, away from the camp lights
programmes.image_alt: The Milky Way over the cliffs of Wadi Rum

programmes.name: Hot Air Balloon Experience
programmes.summary: Float over the desert at sunrise and see the mountains and dunes from above.
description: A hot air balloon ride over the Wadi Rum desert, with wide views of the mountains and dunes from above in a peaceful, unique atmosphere. Flights start around sunrise.
Balloon flights are run with a trusted local partner and depend on the weather, so we'll confirm availability for your date.
includes: Balloon flight with our local partner

programmes.name: Multi-Adventure Desert Experience
programmes.summary: Combine jeep touring, long-distance hiking, mountain climbing, camel riding and sandboarding in one trip, planned around your time.
description: Can't choose just one? Tell us how much time you have and what you'd like to do, and we'll build a programme for you: a jeep tour, long-distance hiking, mountain climbing, camel riding, sandboarding, or a mix of them all.
We'll send you a price for your programme on WhatsApp.
